components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a section; lifts onto a hard ink shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--fg, #1d1d1c); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1c); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms steps(2), box-shadow 120ms steps(2); } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--accent, #0066d4); background: var(--accent, #0066d4); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-4px, -4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--fg, #1d1d1c); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0066d4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

narrative.overview:
A sober page, a game inside. What a recruiter meets first is plain and calm: a concrete grey page, ink text in one sans family, one Signal Blue, everything snapped to an 8px grid. Under that surface the site plays: a field of pastel pixels in the hero, a voxel moai that breathes and blows gum, side quests kept like items in an inventory, a player card behind the Konami code. The calm is what makes the play read as craft rather than noise.

Density is low and text-first. Sections alternate with full-bleed bands (pastel, lavender, ink) that change the mood without changing the type. Edges are hard and stepped, never soft: no rounded cards, no blur, no decorative gradients. Boldness is spent on a few named living objects; everything else stays out of their way.
keyCharacteristics: One family, Instrument Sans Variable, with width doing the expressive work (condensed headings, full-width body).
One accent, Signal Blue, for actions, focus and pixels; pastels only in decoration.
8px grid for every space, icon, cell and image size.
Stepped shapes and `steps()` transitions instead of curves.
A light and a dark theme, equal in care, both WCAG 2.2 AA.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: No green anywhere: not for success, not in syntax colours, not as a pastel. The brand is greys, the blue family, lavender and peach.

rules.name: The Silent Pastel Rule
rules.body: The `pixel-*` colours never carry text or a control's state; text on a pastel band uses that band's own ink tokens.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Every new colour ships with a light and a dark value, both checked for AA; a token that is light in one theme can turn black in the other.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, eyebrows, monospace metadata, middle-dot meta strings, arrows appended to links, or a single accented word in a headline. The one exception: the full name beside the `edm.` mark in the header, in tracked capitals on two lines from 1024px.

rules.name: The Width Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and the `wdth` axis at weight 600; don't add weights or a second family for emphasis.

rules.name: The Eight Rule
rules.body: Every space, icon, cell and image dimension is a multiple of 8px.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: No soft drop shadows. A shadow, where one exists, is a solid offset with no blur.

rules.name: The Stepped Edge Rule
rules.body: If a shape would be smooth, draw it in pixels instead.

dos: Do read colours through the CSS custom properties (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--accent`, `--link`, band tokens); never hard-code a hex in a component.
Do keep every space and size on the 8px scale.
Do use `steps()` for state transitions on buttons, tags and the language curtain.
Do reuse `PixelDissolve`, the seams and the thread before inventing a new transition.
Do put `appDepixelate` on any new photo, and show a project's pixel sprite in the 3:2 frame when it has no screenshot.
Do check every change at 1280px and 390px, in both themes.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, soft drop shadows, blur or gradients as decoration.
Don't set text in a `pixel-*` colour.
Don't use all-caps labels, eyebrows, monospace metadata, middle-dot meta strings or arrows appended to links.
Don't add a second typeface or extra weights for emphasis.
Don't add hover-only behaviour on phones, or block vertical scrolling on anything swipeable.
